args.title: Fix email validation to trim trailing spaces
args.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

The login process currently fails with a validation error when the email input contains a trailing space. This change will modify the email validation logic to trim any trailing whitespace before validating the email address, ensuring that users can log in without issues when using suggestions from the keyboard.
